sources.claim: DRV8962 supports 4.5 V to 65 V operation; DDV is a 44-pin top-exposed-pad package rated up to 10 A per output under datasheet conditions.
Controller J2 is a 12 V motor auxiliary interface with a 120 W aggregate maximum.
Controller J11 exposes one MOTOR_ENABLE_SAFE output, ESTOP_SENSE, GND and 3V3_LOGIC; it does not expose two independent safety enables.
Pololu item 4753 is a 12 V 50:1 metal gearmotor with a 64 CPR encoder; product-page ratings and availability are candidate evidence only.
The 37D family datasheet provides the candidate mechanical, no-load and stall figures used for an analytical current comparison; supplier and incoming-test confirmation remain required.
